trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: State the reason for calling and provide identifiers.
steps.text: नमस्ते, मेरा घुटने का operation है। मुझे cashless करवाना है। मेरा patient ID PT-2001 और policy POL-55501 है।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request and ask for a verification factor.
steps.text: नमस्ते। मैं आपका pre-authorisation check कर लेता हूँ। Verification के लिए, क्या आप अपनी date of birth बता सकते हैं?
हाँ, 15 अगस्त 1960 है। आप check कर लो जल्दी।

steps.purpose: Verify the caller's identity using the provided date of birth.
Retrieve policy details to check coverage and network status.
Confirm eligibility and ask for the chosen room category.
steps.text: धन्यवाद। आपकी policy StarHealth के साथ active है और यह hospital network में है, इसलिए हम cashless के लिए आगे बढ़ सकते हैं। क्या आप बता सकते हैं कि आपने कौन सी room category चुनी है - general, semi-private या private?

steps.purpose: Provide the room category and ask for confirmation on out-of-pocket costs.
steps.text: मैंने general room लिया है। मतलब मुझे अपनी जेब से पैसे नहीं देने पड़ेंगे ना? सब cashless हो जायेगा?

steps.purpose: Estimate the procedure cost based on the chosen room category.
Quote the estimate and balance, and ask for permission to submit the request.
steps.text: General room के लिए hospital का estimate 3,50,000 रुपये है, और आपकी policy में 4,20,000 रुपये का balance बचा है। क्या मैं cashless approval के लिए request भेज दूँ?

steps.purpose: Confirm submission and seek reassurance about approval.
steps.text: हाँ हाँ, request भेज दो। मतलब पक्का हो जायेगा ना approval?

steps.purpose: Submit the pre-authorisation request to the insurer.
Return the outcome of the pre-authorisation submission.
Inform the user of the successful submission and explicitly refuse to guarantee approval.
steps.text: मैंने आपकी request StarHealth को भेज दी है, जिसका ID PRE-9988 है। 4 घंटे में उनका decision आ जायेगा। मैं पक्का नहीं कह सकता कि approve होगा ही, क्योंकि final approval सिर्फ insurer ही देता है।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the information and end the interaction.
steps.text: अच्छा, तो 4 घंटे में पता चलेगा। ठीक है, मैं wait कर लेता हूँ। धन्यवाद।

ir.terminal_condition: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The variant requires the agent to choose between competing branches where one is disallowed by policy. In this happy-path scenario, the user's request for cashless treatment is fully permitted by the policy (in-network, no waiting period), so the agent never has to filter out a disallowed branch.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Conditional branching > Policy-Constrained Branch Selection

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds its responses entirely in the tool outputs, accurately quoting the estimate, balance, preauth ID, and decision hours, while explicitly refusing to guarantee approval as per the rules.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The Policy-Constrained Branch Selection variant is not realized because the scenario follows a strict happy path where the requested service is allowed. The agent does not have to use a business rule to reject a disallowed branch in favor of a permitted one.
issues.repair_instruction: Change the scenario constraints (e.g., make the hospital out-of-network or place the procedure within a waiting period) so the user requests cashless but the agent is forced by policy rules to deny it and offer the reimbursement branch instead.

issues.detail: The persona requires the user to have low digital literacy, misread domain terminology, and ask for it in plain words. Instead, the user flawlessly uses terms like 'cashless', 'patient ID', 'policy', 'general room', and 'approval'.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite the user's dialogue to reflect the persona. The user should struggle with or misread terms like 'patient ID', 'policy', or 'pre-authorisation', and ask the agent to explain what these mean in simple words.

verification.summary: The conversation fails because the Policy-Constrained Branch Selection variant is not realized in this happy-path scenario, and the user's persona (low digital literacy, struggling with domain terms) is completely ignored in favor of fluent, accurate terminology. A full regeneration is required.

variant_findings.reason: The agent retrieves the policy details, identifies the active waiting period, and correctly applies the business rule to decline the cashless request and suggest the reimbursement branch instead.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Conditional branching > Policy-Constrained Branch Selection

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds all statements regarding policy limits, waiting periods, and cost estimates strictly in the tool outputs, without inventing arithmetic for the out-of-pocket amount.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding
